title: EU business operations reference
description: EU-focused reference vocabulary for transport, warehouse, machinery, spare parts, procurement, suppliers, commerce and after-sales. Regulatory references reviewed 2026-10-15. This is a reference-model release, not certification or company-policy approval. Member-state, route, vehicle and transaction applicability must be reviewed. Euro is not assumed to be the currency of every EU member state.
